# Microscope Environmental Cleaning

> Southwest Florida's environmental cleaning specialists. We remove the microscopic contaminants standard remediation leaves behind — verified with 0.3-micron particle counting.

## Services
- Environmental Cleaning: Whole-home removal of the microscopic contaminants standard cleaning leaves behind.
- CIRS Cleaning: Cleaning to the standard mold-biotoxin recovery actually requires.
- ERMI Cleaning: Cleaning designed to help a home pass ERMI / HERTSMI-2.
- Post-Remediation Verification (PRV): Independent, data-backed confirmation that remediation actually worked.
- Air Sampling & Testing: Understand what's actually in your indoor air.
- Moisture Investigation: Find the water source driving the problem.
- Mold Remediation: Licensed removal of active mold — done to a higher finish standard.
- Water & Flood Damage Restoration: Fast, thorough recovery from leaks, floods, and storms.
- Hurricane & Storm Damage Cleanup: Storm recovery for Southwest Florida homes.

## Service Region
Southwest Florida: Lee County, Collier County, Charlotte County, Sarasota County.
